entities.summary: Marius Jaccard was a Swiss ice hockey player who competed in the 1920 Summer Olympics and in the 1924 Winter Olympics. In 1920 he participated with the Swiss ice hockey team in the Summer Olympics tournament. Four years later he was also a member of the Swiss team in the first Winter Olympics tournament.
